topic.label: State
topic.desc: What holds at a time and place: state models and state machines, persistence and storage, snapshots, versions and provenance, and keeping copies consistent.

concepts.label: Synchronization and Consistency
concepts.desc: Keeping copies of state consistent: replication, conflicts, eventual and strong consistency, locks and merges.

concepts.label: State Models and State Machines
concepts.desc: Representing state explicitly: finite state machines, statecharts, transitions, guards and invalid states.

concepts.label: Persistence and Storage
concepts.desc: Where state is kept: memory, files, databases, key value stores, caches, and durability.

concepts.label: Snapshots, Versioning and Provenance
concepts.desc: Snapshots, versions, digests, history and provenance: knowing which state a result came from.

skills.label: Conflict Resolver
skills.desc: Explains conflicting copies of state and proposes a merge with the rule used.

skills.label: Consistency Model Explainer
skills.desc: Explains the consistency guarantee a system gives and what a reader may observe.

skills.label: Lifecycle Explainer
skills.desc: Explains the lifecycle states of an object or process and what moves it between them.

skills.label: State Machine Designer
skills.desc: Designs a state machine for a workflow, listing states, transitions, guards and unreachable or dead-end states.

skills.label: Save and Restore Planner
skills.desc: Plans how application state is saved, exported, imported and restored safely.

skills.label: Storage Selector
skills.desc: Chooses a store for a kind of state by durability, latency, size and sharing needs.

skills.label: Provenance Recorder
skills.desc: Records which inputs and version a result came from, with digests, so it can be reproduced.

skills.label: Snapshot Differ
skills.desc: Compares two snapshots or versions of state and lists what changed.

mcp.name: Git MCP
mcp.desc: Git reference MCP server: read, search and manipulate git repositories, commits, diffs, branches and version history.

mcp.name: Memory MCP
mcp.desc: Memory reference MCP server: persistent knowledge graph memory of entities, relations and observations stored across sessions.

mcp.name: Redis MCP
mcp.desc: Redis official MCP server: store, read and search data in Redis, key value state, streams, hashes and vectors.
